inheritedDescriptors.scope: Only standard IO inherited; synthetic extra credential descriptor not inherited

resourceBudget.windows: kernel Job process-memory limit plus wall timeout; explicit three inherited stdio handles
resourceBudget.unix: Landlock/seccomp or Seatbelt plus process-group watchdog; 50ms sampled memory bound permits bounded overshoot, not an OS hard RSS cap
resourceBudget.outputScope: 8MiB pre-queue public packet limit; Unix captured output watchdog. Windows captured stdio is bounded by candidate interface, memory and wall deadline, not a separate kernel file quota.

scope: Validation-only exact native candidates and an inert future boundary contract, not a production runtime
residuals: Kernel/OS compromise and adversarial privileged same-user parent are outside this boundary.
Required system libraries and platform-private profile caches remain explicit OS runtime exceptions.
Windows packet filtering may drop connects as OS ETIMEDOUT; this is not a universal socket/bind syscall-denial claim.
Unix RSS watchdog is sampled, not an instantaneous kernel hard memory cap; bounded poll overshoot remains possible.
Arbitrary IPC/brokers and a future executable provider/credential runtime are not implemented or certified; all such operations remain denied by the inert contract.
Synthetic markers check the declared public data boundary, not a universal secret detector.
